Bell. Studies of resolved stellar populations in the Milky Way and nearby galaxies reveal an amazingly detailed and clear picture of galaxy evolution.

arxiv-2208-01880.title: Joint Sensing and Communications for Deep Reinforcement Learning-based Beam Management in 6G
arxiv-2208-01880.creator: Yujie Yao, Hao Zhou, and Melike Erol-Kantarci
arxiv-2208-01880.description: Abstract User location is a piece of critical information for network management and control. However, location uncertainty is unavoidable in certain settings leading to localization errors. In this paper, we consider the user location uncertainty in the mmWave networks, and investigate joint vision-aided sensing and communications using deep reinforcement learning-based beam management for future 6G networks.

arxiv-2402-08713.title: Combination of measurements of the top quark mass from data collected by the ATLAS and CMS experiments at s = 7 \sqrt{s}=7 and 8 \TeV
arxiv-2402-08713.description: Abstract A combination of fifteen top quark mass measurements performed by the ATLAS and CMS experiments at the LHC is presented. The data sets used correspond to an integrated luminosity of up to 5 and 20 \fbinv of proton-proton collisions at center-of-mass energies of 7 and 8 \TeV , respectively.

arxiv-2408-04243.title: MU-MAE: Multimodal Masked Autoencoders-Based One-Shot Learning
arxiv-2408-04243.creator: 1 st Rex Liu, 2 nd Xin Liu
arxiv-2408-04243.description: Abstract With the exponential growth of multimedia data, leveraging multimodal sensors presents a promising approach for improving accuracy in human activity recognition. Nevertheless, accurately identifying these activities using both video data and wearable sensor data presents challenges due to the labor-intensive data annotation, and reliance on external pretrained models or additional data.

arxiv-2408-09125.title: Markov Balance Satisfaction Improves Performance in Strictly Batch Offline Imitation Learning
arxiv-2408-09125.creator: Rishabh Agrawal, Nathan Dahlin, Rahul Jain, Ashutosh Nayyar
arxiv-2408-09125.description: Abstract Imitation learning (IL) is notably effective for robotic tasks where directly programming behaviors or defining optimal control costs is challenging. In this work, we address a scenario where the imitator relies solely on observed behavior and cannot make environmental interactions during learning.

arxiv-2410-13433.title: Normal Families of Holomorphic Curves and Sharing of Moving Hyperplanes Wandering on ℙ n \mathbb{P}^{n}
arxiv-2410-13433.creator: Gopal Datt, Naveen Gupta, Nikhil Khanna, Ritesh Pal
arxiv-2410-13433.description: Abstract . In this paper, we extend a result of Schwick concerning normality and sharing values in one complex variable for families of holomorphic curves taking values in ℙ n \mathbb{P}^{n} . We consider wandering moving hyperplanes (i.e., depending on the respective holomorphic curve in the family under consideration), and establish a sufficient condition of normality concerning shared hyperplanes.

arxiv-2411-10129.title: Prompting and Fine-tuning Large Language Models for Automated Code Review Comment Generation Thanks: * All three authors have equal contributions. Thanks: The funding from the Research and Innovation Centre For Science and Engineering, RISE-BUET Undergraduate Student Research Grant S2023-03-113 supp
arxiv-2411-10129.creator: Anonymous Author(s), Md. Asif Haider 1* , Ayesha Binte Mostofa 1* , Sk. Sabit Bin Mosaddek 1* , Anindya Iqbal 1 , Toufique Ahmed 2
arxiv-2411-10129.description: Abstract Generating accurate code review comments remains a significant challenge due to the inherently diverse and non-unique nature of the task output. Large language models pretrained on both programming and natural language data tend to perform well in code-oriented tasks. However, large-scale pretraining is not always feasible due to its environmental impact and project-specific generalizability issues.

arxiv-2501-12503.title: Stable Matching with Interviews
arxiv-2501-12503.creator: Itai Ashlagi, Jiale Chen, Mohammad Roghani, Amin Saberi
arxiv-2501-12503.description: Abstract In several two-sided markets, including labor and dating, agents typically have limited information about their preferences prior to mutual interactions. This issue can result in matching frictions, as arising in the labor market for medical residencies, where high application rates are followed by a large number of interviews.

arxiv-2509-07413.title: Robust Docking Maneuvers for Autonomous Trolley Collection: An Optimization-Based Visual Servoing Scheme
arxiv-2509-07413.creator: Yuhan Pang, Bingyi Xia, Zhe Zhang, Zhirui Sun, Peijia Xie, Bike Zhu, Wenjun Xu, Jiankun Wang
arxiv-2509-07413.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yuhan Pang, Bingyi Xia, Zhe Zhang, Zhirui Sun, Peijia Xie, Bike Zhu, Wenjun Xu, Jiankun Wang. Service robots have demonstrated significant potential for autonomous trolley collection and redistribution in public spaces like airports or warehouses to improve efficiency and reduce cost. Usually, a fully autonomous system for the collection and transportation of multiple trolleys is based on a Leader-Follower formation of mobile manipulators, where reliable docking maneuvers of the mobile base are essential to align trolleys into organized queues.

arxiv-2511-21854.title: Effect of Magneto-Mechanical Synergism in the Process-Structure Correlation in Fe-C Alloys: A Phase-Field Modeling Approach
arxiv-2511-21854.creator: Soumya Bandyopadhyay, Sourav Chatterjee, Dallas R. Trinkle, Richard G. Hennig, Victoria Miller, Michael S. Kesler, Michael R. Tonks
arxiv-2511-21854.description: Abstract Applied magnetic fields can alter phase equilibria and kinetics in steels; however, quantitatively resolving how magnetic, chemical, and elastic driving forces jointly influence the microstructure remains challenging. We develop a quantitative magneto-mechanically coupled phase - field model for the Fe-C system that couples a CALPHAD - based chemical free energy with demagnetization-field magnetostatics and microelasticity.

arxiv-2512-23437.title: RealX3D: A Physically-Degraded 3D Benchmark for Multi-view Visual Restoration and Reconstruction
arxiv-2512-23437.creator: Shuhong Liu 1 * † Chenyu Bao 1 * Ziteng Cui 1 Yun Liu 2 Xuangeng Chu 1 Lin Gu 3 Marcos V. Conde 4 Ryo Umagami 1 Tomohiro Hashimoto 1 Zijian Hu 1 Tianhan Xu 1 Yuan Gan 1 Yusuke Kurose 1 Tatsuya Harada 1,5 1 The University of Tokyo 2 NII 3 Tohoku University 4 University of Würzburg 5 RIKEN
arxiv-2512-23437.description: Abstract We introduce RealX3D, a real-capture benchmark for multi-view visual restoration and 3D reconstruction under diverSE physical degradations. RealX3D groups corruptions into four families—illumination, scattering, occlusion, and blurring—and captures each at multiple severity levels using a unified acquisition protocol that yields pixel-aligned LQ/GT views.

pmc-10636994.title: Iodine-doped TiO2 nanotube coatings: a technique for enhancing the antimicrobial properties of titanium surfaces against Staphylococcus aureus
pmc-10636994.creator: Xiu Yang, Neng-Fu Chen, Xiao-Li Huang, Shun Lin, Qing-Quan Chen, Wan-Ming Wang, Jin-Shui Chen
pmc-10636994.description: BackgroundImplant-related infections are a challenging complication of orthopedic surgery, primarily due to the formation of bacterial biofilms on the implant surface. An antibacterial coating for titanium implants was developed to provide novel insights into the prevention and treatment of implant-related infections.MethodsTitanium plates were coated with TiO2 nanotubes by anodization, and iodine was doped onto the coating via electrophoretic deposition.

pmc-10792713.title: Human Papillomavirus among Women Undergoing Papanicolaou Smear Test in the Department of Gynaecologic Oncology of a Tertiary Care Centre
pmc-10792713.creator: Mahendra Raj Shrestha, Ajaya Basnet, Rajendra Maharjan, Sagar Ghimire, Nisha Khatri, Arju Shrestha, Lochan Karki, Saujanya Karmacharya
pmc-10792713.description: Introduction:In invasive cervical specimens or precursors, high-risk human papillomavirus Deoxyribonucleic acid may be detected to identify females at risk of developing cervical cancer. This study aimed to find out the prevalence of human papillomavirus among women undergoing Papanicolaou smear tests in a tertiary care centre.

pmc-11338604.title: A new variant of lumpy skin disease virus circulating in Vietnam based on sequencing analysis of GPCR gene
pmc-11338604.creator: Ha Thi Thanh Tran, Anh Duc Truong, Anh Tuan Tran, Nhu Thi Chu, Vinh The Nguyen, Hoang Vu Dang
pmc-11338604.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background:In 2021, Vietnam experienced an outbreak of Lumpy skin disease (LSD), which infected 207,687 cattle and buffaloes, as officially reported, and resulted in the culling of 29,182 animals.Aim:In this study, samples from cattle that died and showed typical signs of LSD in the Ha Tinh province of Vietnam were confirmed by three World Organization for Animal Health (WOAH)-recommended methods and further studied to compare the Vietnam and China reference strains to the new clinical cases.Methods:Three methods recommended by WOAH for agent detection

pmc-12389247.title: The Fourth Survey on the Activity of Human Milk Banks in Italy
pmc-12389247.creator: Giuseppe De Nisi, Guido E Moro, Sertac Arslanoglu, Amalia M Ambruzzi, Enrico Bertino, Augusto Biasini, Claudio Profeti, Guglielmo Salvatori, Paola Tonetto, Pasqua Anna Quitadamo, Nicoletta Danese, the members of AIBLUD (Italian Association of Donor Human Milk Banks), Raffaella Nenna
pmc-12389247.description: Background: Scientific literature confirms the benefits of mother’s own milk (MOM) for both term and preterm infants. The feeding of pathological newborns, in particular the very low birth weight infants (VLBWIs), is dependent on human milk. When MOM is not available, pasteurized donor human milk obtained from a recognized Human Milk Bank (HMB) is the best alternative.

pmc-12651115.title: Diagnosis Identity Perception in Adolescents with ADHD and Its Relationship to Executive Functions, Self-Management, and Quality of Life
pmc-12651115.creator: Yael Zabar-Cahanovich, Adi Stern, Liron Lamash
pmc-12651115.description: Highlights What are the main findings? •Adolescents with ADHD reported significantly higher identity Acceptance scores compared to Rejection, Engulfment, and Enrichment, F (2.38, 149.89) = 32.41, p < 0.001.•The total diagnosis identity score was strongly associated with self-management (r = 0.61, p < 0.001).

pmc-13263788.title: Convulsive‐Like Movements in Posterior Circulation Large Vessel Occlusion: Associations With Midbrain Injury and Poor Outcome
pmc-13263788.creator: Wan Wang, Juntao Yin, Boyi Yuan, Zixin Wang, Jiamin Li, Yun Chen, Jiameng Li, Xinyi Wang, Jiapeng Zhao, Jinming Sheng, Qingfeng Ma
pmc-13263788.description: Background and PurposeConvulsive‐like movements are an uncommon and frequently misinterpreted manifestation of posterior circulation stroke. Although they are often regarded as non‐epileptic brainstem motor phenomena, their neuroanatomical substrates and prognostic implications in posterior circulation large vessel occlusion (LVO) remain poorly characterized.

pmc-13587475.title: The ubiquitin E3 ligase TRIM59 in myeloid cell regulates complement C3 through degrading CCAAT/enhancer binding protein β to promote neuron survival after ischemic stroke
pmc-13587475.creator: Xiang Li, Xinjuan Tian, Jingjing Zhang, Mengtian Pan, Baohui Xu, Jie Wei, Dongmei Yan, Weirong Fang
pmc-13587475.description: BackgroundIschemic stroke is a cerebrovascular disease that activates the complement system, leading to inflammation and neuronal injury. TRIM59, an E3 ubiquitin ligase, has been extensively studied in cancer, sepsis, and myocardial infarction, and is upregulated in macrophages after ischemic stroke.
